product_metadata.title: SUPERIOR Non-Slip Cotton 2 Piece Bath Rug Set with Spray Latex Backing, 20" x 30", 24" x 36", White
features: PERFECT BATHROOM RUG. This set includes 1 bath rug 20" x 30", and 1 bath rug 24" x 36", ideal for keeping your floor dry in front of the bath or shower, or for keeping your feet cozy in front of the vanity. The plush and luxurious 100% Combed Cotton pile is soft and comfortable, as well as practical and absorbent

ANTI SLIP BACKING. These bath rugs have an invisible spray latex backing, which helps prevent them from slipping, even when wet. Unlike thick rubber mats which crumble and flake over time, and can even damage tile and wood flooring, our spray latex backing washes well and will not transfer to your floors. The transparent coating is anti-skid, so you can use it in confidence in family and children's bathrooms

CLASSIC STYLE. Updating linens is a quick and easy way to refresh your bathroom's décor, and upgrade your home for a spa-like experience every day. Pair with Superior's coordinating 900 GSM luxury bathroom towels, available in 3 Piece Sets, 6 Piece Sets, Bath Towels, Hand Towels, and Face Towels
EASE OF CARE. These beautiful bath rugs are colorfast and machine washable. Avoid using fabric softeners, as they may decrease absorbency. Always follow care label instructions for best results
description: Enhance the look of your bathroom with this Solid Bath Rug Set Well-made from premium Cotton fibers with a non-slip spray latex backing, this pair feels ultra-plush underfoot yet remains durable and stays in place when you step out of the bath or shower Available in a variety of solid colors with a double etched border trim for added texture, the decorating options are endless This pair comes with a large and small size that you can place together or scatter throughout your master or guest bath for a uniform feel
